items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: John mentioned us to Willard and Willard made a trip to Kansas City himself and signed the band with MCA.

ctx.x: This is where you say it's true. "Benny went back to Chicago and phoned his own booker, Willard Alexander, of Music Corporation of America in New York. In the meantime, John mentioned us to Willard and Willard made a trip to Kansas City himself and signed the band with MCA." Is that the way it happened?
Well, yeah, part of it. That's part of it.
